Advance Plantable Calendar Eco-Friendly – Sustainable Gifting for Every Occasion

If you are looking for an innovative, eco-conscious and purposeful gifting option for corporate events, employee welcome kits, festive gifting or personal use, the Advance Plantable Calendar Eco-Friendly is the perfect choice. Designed with sustainability and creativity in mind, this plantable desk calendar includes 12 seed-paper cards (7″×5″) made from biodegradable seed paper that grows into plants when watered. Each page contains embedded tomato, basil & marigold seeds, offering a unique green alternative to traditional paper calendars.

The calendar comes with a high-quality 9″ wooden A-stand that adds an aesthetic touch to any desk. Whether used at home, office, or as a thoughtful corporate gift, this eco-friendly calendar promotes sustainability and encourages users to reduce paper waste. With planting instructions included, anyone can easily grow the seeds and enjoy fresh herbs and beautiful flowers throughout the year.

Why Choose Our Advance Plantable Calendar Eco-Friendly?

This sustainable calendar is specially crafted for individuals and businesses who value environmentally responsible products. The 12 seed-paper cards (7″×5″) feature monthly designs printed with inks on biodegradable paper made from recycled cotton waste. After each month, simply tear, soak and sow the paper to grow tomato, basil & marigold seeds. This transforms your into a mini garden, making it both functional and eco-conscious.

The sturdy 9″ wooden A-stand ensures the calendar remains durable throughout the year while offering a premium look suitable for modern workspaces. From corporate gifting to festive occasions, this option helps businesses leave a responsible environmental impression on clients and employees.

Key Features

  • Eco-Friendly Calendar Designed for Sustainability – 12 monthly cards made with biodegradable seed paper.
  • 12 Seed-Paper Cards (7″×5″) – Each card contains embedded seeds for planting after use.
  • Premium 9″ Wooden A-Stand – Offers stability, durability and an elegant desk presence.
  • Tomato, Basil & Marigold Seeds – Grow fresh herbs and vibrant flowers.
  • Planting Instructions Included – Easy step-by-step guide for beginners.
  • Printed using eco-friendly inks on recycled seed paper.
  • Ideal for corporate gifts, employee joining kits, festive gifts, and eco-conscious events.
  • Plastic-free, biodegradable and sustainable product design.

Once a month is completed, simply remove the card and follow the included planting instructions. The seed-paper cards (7″×5″) are designed to break down naturally in soil, allowing the embedded tomato, basil & marigold seeds to germinate and grow. This creates a rewarding experience that encourages green living.

Choosing an product reduces your carbon footprint by replacing conventional paper with seed paper. It promotes sustainability at workplaces, supports environmental awareness campaigns and encourages users to reconnect with nature. Businesses using this plantable calendar for gifting leave behind a lasting and positive environmental impression.

Perfect for Corporate and Personal Gifting

This eco-conscious calendar fits seamlessly into employee welcome kits, corporate gift hampers, promotional events, and festive gifting campaigns. Its combination of utility, sustainability and aesthetic appeal makes it a preferred choice among products.

Product Summary

  • Product: Advance Plantable Calendar Eco-Friendly
  • Material: 12 seed-paper cards (7″×5″)
  • Stand: 9″ wooden A-stand
  • Seeds: Tomato, Basil & Marigold
  • Includes: Planting Instructions
  • Use Case: Corporate gifting, personal desk accessory, eco-friendly events

Switch to an Advance Plantable Calendar Eco-Friendly and bring sustainability to your desk, home or gifting experience. This plantable is not just a product—it is a meaningful step towards a greener future.
